explanation: Compared with Montgomery–Pokrovskiy–Sudakov (arXiv:2001.02665, abstract): Ringel's conjecture 'says that any tree with n edges packs 2n+1 times into the complete graph K_{2n+1}'. The formal statement: for a finite tree T with n edges there are 2n+1 vertex embeddings V ↪ Fin (2n+1) whose image graphs are pairwise edge-disjoint and whose union is the complete graph, i.e. an edge decomposition of K_{2n+1} into 2n+1 copies of T (equivalent to the packing, since (2n+1)·n = C(2n+1, 2)). Faithful.
